name: Uno Shion
source:
Suzune's very protective twin brother. When the situation is normal, Shion is a very mild-mannered child, but he's quick to jump to his twin sister's defense.

[From the [url=http://www.aksysgames.com/malice/characters/]official English website[/url]]
